_comment: Keys prefixed with _ are ignored by the skill (treat them as comments-in-JSON since standard JSON has no comment syntax). Copy this file to ~/.skill-organizer.json and edit paths for your setup.

_fields.project_roots: array of absolute paths where your projects live. The skill will scan direct children for candidate owner projects.
_fields.archive_dir: absolute path where orphaned skills get moved. Date-scoped subfolders are created per run.
_fields.backup_before_lazy: when true (default), Lazy Mode creates a tar.gz of ~/.claude/skills/ into archive_dir before any mv.
